news.title:
Aadhar Housing Finance posted a 26.9% profit rise to ₹310.9cr in Q4 FY25.
Promoter holding fell 10.3 pts to 64.9%, raising governance concerns.
news.summary:

news.title:
Nomura maintains a Buy on Aadhar Housing Finance with a ₹615 target, citing ~20% YoY AUM growth and profit guidance till FY27E.
Projected ROA/ROE of ~4.2–4.3%/16.5% over FY28–29 with 27% earnings growth aided by opex moderation.
